# Top Shelf Enhanced Component Package v1.0

**Status:** Locked reference, ready for later TapConnect Studio integration.  
**Tier:** Enhanced / Premium Simple  
**License:** User-attested license-free

## Locked visual DNA

- multi-stop dark metallic/glass face
- crisp outer edge
- top-half reflection
- inset upper highlight
- inset lower depth
- external cast shadow
- ambient halo
- tactile hover/press behavior
- simple glass Icon Ring
- two-level copy option

The integration may parameterize color, icon, label, description, cue, radius within approved limits, depth and halo intensity. It may not simplify away the layered look/effect without Product Owner review.

## Included components

- `OuterGlowRing`
- `ButtonBase`
- `GlossOverlay`
- `IconRing`
- `TopShelfButton`
- `PremiumActionButton`
- `CircularRingButton`
- email-safe derivative

## Default family scope

Apply to the **current Button Section Container** unless the Host deliberately selects a broader compatible scope. Content/function remains independent from appearance.

## Integration status

This package is not installed in the TapConnect repository yet. It is the known-good package Cody should eventually integrate without visually redesigning it.
